description: A tiny, fast container runtime for Windows (via WSL2) — a lightweight Docker Desktop alternative that speaks the Docker Engine API
notes: Requires WSL2 on Windows 10/11. First launch runs Kiri's own setup (imports the WSL2 engine, creates the 'kiri' docker context, adds the CLI to your per-user PATH) and may prompt for elevation to install WSL or DNS rules.
Kiri has a built-in self-updater. Consider turning automatic updates off in Kiri's Settings and use 'scoop update kiri' instead, so versions stay consistent.

scoop uninstall removes the extracted files but cannot undo Kiri's WSL distro, docker context, PATH entries or registry keys. Use Kiri's own 'kiri.ps1 -Uninstall -IfSetUp' first if you want a full cleanup.
